sentences.text: 1 2. Learned AGP waives notice for all the respondents and upon instructions from the respondents makes a statement that respondents would decide the representation dated 27.03.2024 filed by the petitioners within a period of eight weeks from today.

3. We take the said statement as undertaking and dispose of the writ petition by giving directions to the respondents to decide the representation dated 27.03.2024 filed by the petitioners within a period of eight weeks from today .
